verdict.rationale: LocalAI exposes a broad API covering the core UI workflows: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible inference, functions/tools, MCP selection via `metadata.mcp_servers`, and model installation via the `/models/apply` endpoint, which mirrors the UI's gallery/Discover page. Nothing in the docs claims UI/API parity, and several UI capabilities (agent configuration, user/admin management, message editing) have no documented API equivalent. Probes also found no published OpenAPI spec on the docs site. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API endpoints for agent creation/management and user administration, a published OpenAPI reference, and independent hands-on corroboration.
